notes.title: Introducing Exploration Mode
notes.notes: [h1]Introducing Exploration Mode[/h1][p]Hey all,[/p][p]Tim here! I'd like to introduce you to LinkShift's main game mode called Exploration. Its a puzzle game mode with roguelite elements that lets you manipulate the rules into your favor. [/p][p]Lets a have a quick look how it works.[/p][p][/p][h2]Master Node Selection[/h2][p]Before you start a new run you can select up to 3 Master Nodes to take with you. In LinkShift you will unlock new types of Master Nodes so the options you have will expand over time. Each Master Node lets you do do unique things so find your preferred combination and synergies. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45682272/2db9daa47c81fae0f309f50c9b8f8f15320b0622.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Boosters Upgrades[/h2][p]Once you have started the run, each 3-5 levels you are presented with 3 random Booster Upgrade tiles that are spawned onto the grid. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45682272/d7331fa59f6b3d7ebde6a16b31b30c2e1135b6d6.png"][/img]To choose one, place any Node on top and it will be added to your upgrade pool. The stats you have upgraded are visible on the lower left of the screen. There are many different Boosters to collect during a run which will let you manipulate the run into your favor. Spawn specific Nodes only,  receive many Master Nodes, getting massive points via point clusters or just focus on survival and get those upgrades that will let you reach level 100, its up to you. [/p][h2]Booster Build Example[/h2][p]In this run I focused my build on the Point Clusters. These are locations that spawn on the grid and by placing Nodes of the same color in them they will become very valuable. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45682272/d7331fa59f6b3d7ebde6a16b31b30c2e1135b6d6.png"][/img][/p][p]I managed to gather Boosters that made the Clusters bigger and their point value higher.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45682272/98b08202c9d215bf2b66f1d86b47ab9d8191efeb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45682272/2e6f04cf7760843eb0183e2682404e38de115c23.jpg"][/img]Point clusters in this run were now super valuable and gave me loads of points when collecting.  In combination with getting specific Nodes and manipulating the Master Node types the build became very strong.[/p][p]This is just an example of what is possible by choosing the right Master Nodes and making the right Booster choices during a run. Even in these early stages of the game's development there are already many different combinations and ways to bend the rules and this will grow over time in the up coming months. Very exciting![/p][p][/p][h2]Demo out soon[/h2][p]The demo release date is getting closer and I can not wait for you to be able to play the game and find your favorite Master Node and Booster combinations! [/p][p]Next update will be the demo release date announcement, it wont be long! See you soon :)[/p]
